rows: Why a creative worked in one ad set and not in another

Only creatives that ran in 2+ ad sets (₹1,000+ each, judged on the same KPI) where the gap is more than 20%. Drivers compared: audience, event, hook, CTR, clicks that convert, cost of reach (CPM), the creative's share of the ad set's spend, and timing. Refreshed daily with the Creative Analysis sheet.
Adjust (purple): since Sep 1, all matured cohorts of that ad. Ret Effective CPI = Adjust CPI ÷ retention index.
